mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year increase in CPIAUCSL above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.5%) and strong retail sales (RSAFS above 350,000 million dollars) signals robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5 and RSAFS > 350000.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions characterized by strong GDP growth (GDPC1 above 2.0% annualized) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.0%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the Federal Reserve initiates rate hikes, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO increases are followed by negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST above 2000 thousand units) and strong retail sales (RSAFS above 350,000 million dollars) indicates a robust consumer economy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 2000 and RSAFS > 350000.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising), the S&P 500 tends to decline as higher rates reduce the present value of future cash flows, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.
